findings.message: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY blocks writes on public.posts for the whole build
findings.help: use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, in a migration whose first line is -- no-transaction

findings.message: index users_email_idx is redundant with users_email_name_idx
adding a constraint validates every row of public.comments under a lock
findings.help: add it NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a later migration

findings.message: foreign key comments_post_fk on public.comments (post_id) has no index
SET NOT NULL scans every row of public.users under a lock
findings.help: add CHECK (email IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, VALIDATE it, then SET NOT NULL

findings.message: ALTER TABLE rewrites every row of public.users under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock
findings.help: rewrite in steps: add a new column, backfill it in batches, then swap

findings.message: comparison with NULL is never true
findings.help: use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL

findings.message: NOT IN (SELECT …) returns no rows when the subquery returns a NULL
findings.help: use NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM … WHERE …), or make both sides NOT NULL

findings.message: DELETE without WHERE removes every row of users
findings.help: add a WHERE clause, or allow it with -- typedpg-lint: allow(unbounded_write)

findings.message: UPDATE without WHERE changes every row of users
findings.help: add a WHERE clause, or allow it with -- typedpg-lint: allow(unbounded_write)
